comment: Communities and districts along the Airport Run route (Norman Manley → Ocho Rios). Entries marked needs_owner_review need verification against the owner's lived knowledge — map data is approximate. lat/lon are real-world coordinates; the game projects them via road.project().

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: Narrow spit — sea on both sides; coconut trees line the road

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Entrance to Kingston — potholes begin just past the roundabout

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Kingston's busiest crossroads — clock tower and serious traffic

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Business district; Devon House is nearby

communities.name: Liguanea
communities.note: Liguanea plain — University of the West Indies nearby

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's former capital; the old Georgian square still stands

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the Rio Cobre gorge

communities.name: Flat Bridge
communities.note: Narrowest main-road bridge in Jamaica — one lane only

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Famous for the folk song 'Linstead Market'

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Bauxite town on the way up to Moneague

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Mountain crossroads between Kingston and the north coast

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshops — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival

communities.name: Golden Spring
communities.note: Hilltop community before the descent into Fern Gully

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: The famous fern canopy tunnel — 800+ fern species lining the road

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: North coast tourist hub — Dunn's River Falls ends the run
